checks: Real history entry point opens the local settings history section with an empty state and no sample data.

A real measured session shows stored date/intention, original/final targets, explicit revision, foreground duration, separate break duration and reflection; HTML-like text renders literally in light/dark narrow views.
Cancel preserves an existing reflection; Clear reflection explicitly removes the answer and note without deleting the session.
Answered and skipped reflections do not reopen after popup reload or a second surface; Skip leaves null reflection and discards the note draft.
Deleting one session confirms first, updates both history views and finished popup, clears pending note fields, and rejects a stale save without recreating the record.
Clear history empties all history surfaces and keeps an active session; separate reset-all clears the session and preferences as well.
note: Actual unpacked extension; YouTube-origin fixture supplies foreground activity. History records are generated by real session actions, not seeded sample summaries.
